//: What: Root manifest of the CAP complete guide: npm workspaces for every stage, sample and the final app, plus repository-wide scripts (tests, lint, header check, Definition-of-Done report).
Why: One npm install serves all learning projects while each folder stays a standalone CAP project with its own package.json that can be diffed against the previous stage or copied out.
If missing or unlinked: Stages cannot be installed or tested from the root; each folder would need its own install and the DoD report and CI have no entry point.
name: cap-complete-guide
description: SAP CAP (Node.js) + Fiori Elements learning path: 10 cumulative stages, standalone samples and a final reference app (ACME Procurement).
